Keyword search sorted by relevance, newest or price and filtered by gender, brand, colour, size, body-fit range (plus, petite, tall, maternity, hourglass, wide fit, fuller bust), product type, price, sale or any facet, up to 200 per page (keyword results reach position 2,088); one product in full by id, co-ord set id or link, with description, composition, care, size and fit, country of manufacture, every size variant with SKU, EAN, price and online stock (in stock, low stock, restocking soon), the rating with fit and quality, ASOS's own labelled AI review summary and the other colours; customer reviews by store language (one English pool shared by gb, us, au and the European and international stores; es, it, nl, se, dk and pl add their own language; fr and de show only French or German reviews), up to 50 per page, sorted by relevance, newest, oldest or rating and filtered by star rating, with fit and quality averages, no reviewer names; search suggestions with result counts; the store's women and men category tree and every product of a category or brand page; the A-Z brand list; the Sale and New In lists for women or men; the markets table with every country's store, language, currencies and size schema. 235 countries and 245 country-currency combinations: ASOS's UK, US, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Australian, Danish, Dutch, Polish and Swedish stores in their own languages, plus its European and international stores in English (Ireland, Portugal, Belgium, Norway, Canada, Mexico, India, South Africa, Switzerland, New Zealand, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China and more), in GBP, USD, EUR, AUD, DKK, PLN, SEK, NOK, CAD, CHF, NZD, AED, SAR, HKD, ILS, SGD, TWD or CNY. 11 endpoints, 1 credit per call. Online stock only (ASOS has no physical stores), no outlet, no promo codes, no price history (poll and store). ASOS has no public product data API.

frontmatter.description: Uniqlo API for Uniqlo prices by country, Japan vs the rest: one uniqlo.com product id (E479000-000, the same id in every uniqlo.com market) priced in up to 10 markets per call, each in its own currency and never converted, with the promo price, limited-offer and sale flags (Uniqlo's own offer labels), tax inclusive or exclusive and the markets that do not sell it. Price group 01, mostly Select Colors/Sizes Only sale prices, can be read with product. Online stock of every colour and size (status and quantity, capped at 11), stock status of one variant (with its price group) in up to 10 stores near a point, stores with address, phone and opening hours, customer reviews with rating, fit (1 tight to 5 loose), purchased size and colour, height, weight and age ranges (no reviewer names or locations; European markets share one rating pool), keyword search sorted by price, newest or rating and filtered by gender, category, colour, size, flag or price range, one product in full with description, composition, washing, country of origin, category, colours, sizes, rating and size chart link, category lists, the sale and limited-offer lists, new arrivals, the category tree and search suggestions or trending search words. Every endpoint on the US, Japan and South Korea; search and product on Uniqlo's Greater China sites (Taiwan, Hong Kong, China; their own product codes, Chinese titles); product and prices on 35 more storefronts: the UK, Canada, Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, Sweden and Uniqlo's EU store in euros for 17 more EU countries. 12 endpoints, 1 credit per call, store stock by product, colour and size 2, prices 1 per market. frontmatter.description: Liquidation.com API for Liquidation.com (liquidation.com, the US online liquidation auction site of Liquidity Services, where retailers, brands and marketplace sellers sell customer returns, overstock and shelf pulls by the package, pallet or truckload) - which auctions are open, what the current bid and minimum next bid are, what the seller states a lot is worth at retail, what the lot holds item by item, and what a seller's past lots closed at, as liquidation.com shows it to a visitor who is not signed in (on 2026-11-28 the search "laptop" matched 73 open auctions, the first a gaming PC lot of 7 items with a stated retail of 6,600 USD at a 3,000 USD opening bid; auction 21648824, a gaming PC lot of 4 returns from a marketplace seller in Ontario, CA, stood at 1,100 USD after 1 bid, minimum next bid 1,150 USD, 11% buyer's premium, its manifest 4 rows under 7 seller columns; seller Titan Electronics had 2,373 closed lots, one of 43 home items on 3 pallets closing at 455 USD after 40 bids) with current bid, sealed-bid flag, bids, watchers, views, close time, condition, packages, items and stated retail; search by keyword, category, lot size, condition, US region, auction type and seller, 27 a page (up to 100), sorted by close time, current bid, items or title; one open auction with buyer's premium, quantity, shipping terms and weights and the seller's statistics; the item manifest as the seller lists it; a seller's closed auctions with final bids. 4 endpoints, 1 credit each. USD and CAD (Brampton, ON); no bidder names; closed lots carry no close date.
